title: ON.energy expertise band
description: A dark-grey band split in two: a scrambling mono eyebrow and a light two-line heading (letters blur in) on the left; on the right a grey lead paragraph and charcoal link cards with a square image, a title, a line of copy and a small yellow arrow tile. On hover a card fills yellow, its text turns black and the arrow tile turns black with a yellow arrow.
notes: media slot per card: a square image (190px on desktop, 77px on phones); empty, a tinted square stands in
needs JavaScript only for the eyebrow scramble (hydrate: visible); the rest is CSS
